summary: Iteration 28 – Veri Aktarım Merkezi + BizimHesap config, Orders Yeni/AI modals + Ürünler & Fiyat panel + marketplace_status, layout widths. Backend pytest 10/10 PASSED covering: (1) GET /api/migration/sources → 7 sources incl. bizimhesap, 5 entities; templates for contacts & products return 200 xlsx (PK header); (2) Contacts xlsx (Turkish 8-col header) parse → upload_id, columns, suggested_mapping auto-maps all 8 fields (name/tax_number_or_id/tax_office/phone/email/city/balance/type); preview total=3, valid=2, invalid=1 with error containing 'Cari Adı … boş'; import inserted=2, failed=1; contacts persisted with balance '1.250,50' → 1250.5 and 'Tedarikçi' → type='supplier'; batch listed, errors.csv contains 'boş', rollback deletes 2 contacts, second rollback → 400; (3) Products CSV (semicolon) → 2 inserted, then re-import with 'update' → 2 updated 0 inserted, rollback of update batch + insert batch both succeed and products removed; (4) Invoices xlsx (dd.mm.yyyy) → inserts invoice with e_type='paper' and auto contact via import_batch_id, rollback deletes both invoice and auto contact; (5) BizimHesap config: initial configured=false; POST test with no token → 400 'Önce BizimHesap token'ını kaydedin.'; PUT config with dummy-token-1234 → configured=true, token_mask='••••1234'; POST test now → 400/502 (invalid token, not 500); Mongo-direct delete restores unconfigured state; (6) GET /api/marketplace/products?channel=trendyol → live=true, count=63, matched int, rows have barcode/title/sale_price/quantity/approved; (7) POST /api/marketplace/product-create with fake barcode 'QA000TEST123' created card, DELETE /api/products/{id} + trash purge cleaned; (8) POST /api/orders channel='manual' creates order with auto contact_id, list includes marketplace_status field on Trendyol rows (26 badges observed); (9) AI order-extract on 3-row CSV grouped by customer, contact_id null; confirm created orders with ORD-… numbers and source='ai_import' and auto contact_id set — all cleaned up. Frontend Playwright verified: /orders max-w-[1680px] and / max-w-7xl; new-order-btn opens modal, saved test manual order (channel/customer/free-name/qty/price) and deleted via order-delete-{n}; tab-mp_products shows marketplace-products-panel with 63 mp-row-*, mp-filter-{all,unmatched,price_diff,stock_diff}/mp-search/mp-bulk-qty/mp-bulk-apply all functional, mp-send-btn becomes enabled after bulk-apply (NOT clicked, no push, no create/match on real rows); ai-order-btn opens ai-order-modal; Trendyol orders show 26× order-status-badge-*, manual/b2b show 5× order-status-select-*. /settings → Veri Aktarımı → migration-panel with bizimhesap-card (bh-token/bh-firm/bh-save/bh-test) and excel-wizard (mig-source/mig-entity/mig-template/mig-dropzone/mig-file); uploading contacts xlsx pre-fills mig-map-select-name='Cari Ünvanı' and tax='Vergi No'; mig-preview stats toplam=3/geçerli=2/hatalı=1; mig-errors shown; mig-import-btn → mig-result 'Cariler (Müşteri / Tedarikçi): 2 yeni, 0 güncellendi, 0 atlandı, 1 hatalı.'; migration-batches lists new row mig-batch-* with Hata CSV and Geri Al buttons; clicking mig-rollback-* + dialog accept turns row to 'Geri alındı' with toast '2 kayıt silindi, 0 güncelleme geri alındı.'. All TEST_QA / TEST_UI data cleaned up.
critical_code_review_comments: migration.py _transform (line 262-263) uses `existing_keys.setdefault(f'name::{nm}', d['_id'])` only for entities whose key is tax_number_or_id/tc_kimlik/sku — good, but the second-pass 'name::' fallback for contacts can incorrectly mark distinct people with same name as duplicates. Consider making the fallback opt-in.

migration.py bh_put_config (line 468): token is stripped and stored in token_tail (last 4). If user submits fewer than 4 chars, token_tail slice is silent (whole token). Low risk; add min-length validation.

server.py marketplace_products (line 3784) does case-insensitive match against barcode only via .lower(); products with barcode leading zeros stripped in Excel imports may miss matches — worth documenting.

server.py ai_order_confirm (line 4809-4812) uses o.get('order_number') as-is for grouping; if extractor returns duplicate ORD-… manual users could get 500 on unique index. Consider always regenerating.
server.py POST /api/orders (test line: 422 required 'total_amount') requires client to compute total_amount even though items.total is provided — could be server-derived to reduce round-trip errors.
seed_data_creation: None persisted. All TEST_QA* / TEST_UI* contacts, products, invoices, orders, and migration batches were rolled back or purged. BizimHesap config restored to unconfigured via Mongo direct delete. Real Trendyol data untouched (no push, no match, no create on real rows).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 28 flows (Veri Aktarım Merkezi backend + UI, BizimHesap config, Marketplace Ürünler & Fiyat panel read-only, AI order extract/confirm, manual order create, layout widths) all verified end-to-end. Reusable pytest at /app/backend/tests/test_iteration28.py — run with -o 'addopts=' to bypass -n loadscope which xdist rejects on single-file. AI order extract takes ~5-10s; timeout=90 sufficient. Do NOT push Trendyol prices/stock or match/create real Trendyol rows — the 63 real products are live user data.
